name: SponsorInquiry - Awaiting A Form
description: The closing ask in its current state: the email CTA works today, and the form panel carries reader-facing copy saying the form is on the way. The generic embed fallback names the two props a developer would set, which is right for an unconfigured embed nobody has reached and wrong on a page a prospective sponsor lands on — hence the override. The Harvard disclaimer sits under the CTA, where a reader deciding to write will actually see it.
